player_prompt.intro:
Yu pilai Countdown namba gem!
Gol: Kobini namba usim +, -, *, / long rikim target.
Akshan format: [i j op] we i,j index na op i operesen.
Eg: [0 2 *] i maliti namba long index 0 wantaim namba long index 2.
Dividen mas kamap olgeta namba tasol.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Akshan format i no stret. Usim `[i j op]` we i,j index na op i +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Ol indeks i no stret, ol mas narapela kain na insait long mak 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Operesen i no stret (dividen long zero o resalt i no integer)

outcome.no_moves: Ino gat muv gen. Risult bilong nambawan: {best_value} (teget: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Limi bilong raun i kamap. Best resalt: {best_value} (target: {target})
